title: NFL Games, Plays, Players, and Team Performance, 2021-2025
description: A curated relational release covering complete NFL regular and postseason games without frame-by-frame player tracking.

coverage.scope_note: The 2021 season began the NFL's 17-game regular-season era; incomplete 2026 data are excluded.

join_keys.design_note: Keep each table at its documented grain. Aggregate plays or player-game rows before joining when the analysis target is a game or team-game.

sources.name: nflverse-data
sources.access_method: Canonical Parquet release assets used by nflreadpy

privacy.assessment: The release contains public professional-sports records, player names, and public biographical fields needed for age and player-characteristic analysis. Headshots, profile URLs, and unrelated cross-platform account identifiers are excluded.

license.attribution: nflverse; original NFL data remain subject to applicable owner terms

artifacts.name: games
artifacts.grain: One NFL regular-season or postseason game

artifacts.name: plays
artifacts.grain: One recorded play within an NFL game

artifacts.name: player_game_stats
artifacts.grain: One player, team, and game statistical record

artifacts.name: team_game_stats
artifacts.grain: One team statistical record per game

artifacts.name: players
artifacts.grain: One player represented in the 2021-2025 release

artifacts.name: teams
artifacts.grain: One current NFL team lookup record
